bank: EYES AND EARS -- THE REFERENCE SCORE: TEN YES/NO QUESTIONS
serves: COMPARE EVERY PIECE OF ART TO THE WORLD BEFORE CALLING IT DONE (9/4, LOCKED). The law says compare; it never said how to write the answer down, so a comparison has been an opinion, and an opinion cannot be checked by the next chat.
how_to_use: Run tools/bohemia_eyes_reference_score.py COOK REF for questions 1-7 (a file path, or BANK.txt:id for art that lives in a bank). Questions 8-10 go to a fresh pair of eyes -- a person or a chat that has not seen the cook before. A cook is not done until the seven are yes and the three are asked.
reuse_check: gates/texture_match_gate.py already derives a ruler from the packs Paolo BOUGHT and holds painted tiles to colours-per-tile, edge energy, grain and saturation. This does not re-measure those four for tiles; it generalises the idea to ANY pair of pictures and adds the four that gate does not ask.

questions.test: local contrast (mean neighbour step) within 2.5x of the reference
questions.why: the texture gate's own finding: his bought art carries about 2.5x the local contrast of painted art, and no choice of colours closes that
a 13-colour flat ramp cannot sit beside a 1,300-colour photographic texture and read as one game
painted art in this repo has run hot: 0.383 against his 0.274

questions.test: the 5th-95th percentile luminance bands overlap by at least 60%
questions.why: two pictures can share a palette and still sit in different rooms

questions.test: the structure repeats at a similar size (first autocorrelation peak within 2x)
questions.why: the same material at the wrong scale reads as a different material
the craft law says one key from the upper left; a tile that argues with it argues with the whole street

questions.q: Does it still READ at play size?
questions.test: shrink both to 24px and compare the surviving contrast, within 2x
questions.why: detail that dies at play size is detail nobody paid for

questions.test: name what each picture is made of. If the two words differ, the cook is not the reference's material however close the numbers are

questions.q: Does it belong to THIS world?
questions.test: the 9/4 law's real question, and no machine answers it

questions.q: What would a stranger call it, in one word, for each picture?
questions.test: if the two words differ, stop and look again

validated_9_5.a water tile against a wall tile: 3 of 7 (colour density, saturation, value band and read-at-size all say no)
